title: A Place Left Behind
description: Zachary returns to an abandoned house scarred by fire, where familiar rooms, old photographs and a small pink-taped key draw him back into memories of what was lost.
excerpt: On a stormy night, Zachary returns to an abandoned house carrying two old keys. As he climbs the stairs, the place begins to reveal the memories he left behind.
